parameters.name: ActionPlanName
parameters.description: The name of the execution plan.

parameters.name: AllocationSpec
parameters.description:
The resource type.

- Standard: Standard.

- Dedicated: Dedicated. This type is available only to users in the whitelist.

- Economic: Economy. This type is available only to users in the whitelist.

parameters.name: DesiredCapacity
parameters.description: The desired size of the resource for the execution plan. For example, if you set ResourceType to VcpuCapacity, this parameter specifies the number of vCPUs that you want to maintain for the execution plan.

parameters.name: Level
parameters.description:
The computing power level. This parameter is valid only when you set AllocationSpec to Economic. The following types are supported:

- General: General-purpose.

- Performance: Compute-optimized.

Default value: General

parameters.name: PrologScript
parameters.description: The pre-execution script. The script must be Base64-encoded.

parameters.name: Regions
parameters.description: A list of regional resource configurations for the runtime environment of the execution plan.

sub_parameters.name: SecurityGroupId
sub_parameters.description: A list of security groups that are available for the execution plan in the region. You can specify 0 to 5 security groups.

sub_parameters.name: SecurityGroupIds
sub_parameters.description: A list of security group IDs. You can call the [DescribeSecurityGroups](https://api.aliyun.com/document/Ecs/2014-05-26/DescribeSecurityGroups) operation to query information about available security groups.

sub_parameters.name: VSwitchIds
sub_parameters.description: A list of vSwitches that are available for the execution plan in the region. You can specify 0 to 5 vSwitches.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The type of resource for the execution target. The value can be the vCPU capacity or the number of executor nodes. Valid values:

- VCpuCapacity: vCPU capacity

- ExecutorCapacity: number of executor nodes

parameters.name: Resources
parameters.description: A list of resource configurations for the runtime environment of the execution plan. You can specify 1 to 10 resource configurations.

sub_parameters.name: Cores
sub_parameters.description: The number of vCPUs for the runtime environment.

sub_parameters.name: Memory
sub_parameters.description: The memory size of the runtime environment. Unit: GiB.

parameters.name: Script
parameters.description: The script to run the job. The script must be Base64-encoded.
